title: Historical Forecast Accuracy
description: Retrospective accuracy of ECMWF IFS model runs against Meteostat observations

list.name: city
list.label: Город
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, location_id AS __value FROM dm.dim_locations ORDER BY name
list.definition: SELECT name AS __text, location_id AS __value FROM dm.dim_locations ORDER BY name

panels.title: Температура: MAE и RMSE по горизонту

targets.rawSql: SELECT LPAD(model_horizon_hours::TEXT, 3, '0') || ' ч' AS "Горизонт", ROUND(AVG(ABS(temperature_error_c)), 3)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS "MAE", ROUND(SQRT(AVG(POWER(temperature_error_c, 2))), 3)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS "RMSE" FROM dm.fact_archive_forecast_accuracy WHERE location_id = ${city:sqlstring} AND forecast_for >= $__timeFrom() AND forecast_for < $__timeTo() AND temperature_error_c IS NOT NULL GROUP BY model_horizon_hours ORDER BY model_horizon_hours

SELECT LPAD(model_horizon_hours::TEXT, 3, '0') || ' ч' AS "Горизонт", ROUND(AVG(temperature_error_c), 3)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS "Bias" FROM dm.fact_archive_forecast_accuracy WHERE location_id = ${city:sqlstring} AND forecast_for >= $__timeFrom() AND forecast_for < $__timeTo() AND temperature_error_c IS NOT NULL GROUP BY model_horizon_hours ORDER BY model_horizon_hours

panels.title: Покрытие температурных прогнозов
panels.description: Доля прогнозов с измерением среди строк, где есть прогноз температуры.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE temperature_error_c IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS coverage_pct FROM dm.fact_archive_forecast_accuracy WHERE location_id = ${city:sqlstring} AND forecast_for >= $__timeFrom() AND forecast_for < $__timeTo() AND temperature_forecast_c IS NOT NULL AND forecast_for <= NOW()

panels.title: Температура: последний архивный прогноз и факт

targets.rawSql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT forecast_for AS time, temperature_forecast_c, temperature_actual_c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY forecast_for ORDER BY model_run_at DESC, archive_run_id DESC) AS version_number FROM dm.fact_archive_forecast_accuracy WHERE location_id = ${city:sqlstring} AND forecast_for >= $__timeFrom() AND forecast_for < $__timeTo()) SELECT time, temperature_forecast_c::DOUBLE PRECISION AS "Прогноз, °C", temperature_actual_c::DOUBLE PRECISION AS "Факт, °C" FROM ranked WHERE version_number = 1 ORDER BY time
